Leadership

Nanda Najmi

Founder & CEO, Ease Your Needs

Nanda Najmi is the visionary Founder and CEO of Ease Your Needs (EYN). After recognizing a gap in digital accessibility during the pandemic in 2020, she established EYN with the clear intention not only to bridge connections but to fundamentally transform how organizations collaborate. Nanda built the company on the core belief that seamless digital infrastructure should be an empowering standard for everyone.

As a graduate of the University of Indonesia with experience in management consulting, and having led the business for five years, Nanda champions a growth-oriented, data-driven culture that empowers her team to consistently deliver exceptional enterprise-grade solutions. With an eye toward the future, she is actively steering EYN’s strategic evolution into an IT Consulting & System Integrator in Indonesia.

Leadership

Agil Purnomo

IT Head, Ease Your Needs

Agil Purnomo leads the technical backbone of Ease Your Needs as IT Head, bringing over 20 years of hands-on experience across the IT industry and broadcast media, including roles at MNCTV and MNC Media Group. His background spans the full spectrum of information technology, from infrastructure and systems integration to broadcast-grade technical operations.

As an all-round IT solutions and audio-visual (AV) expert, Agil bridges the gap between enterprise-grade technology and practical, on-the-ground implementation. His extensive media industry experience gives him a deep understanding of how mission-critical AV and broadcast systems need to perform under real-world pressure, a perspective he brings directly into every client deployment at EYN.

Our History

Ease Your Needs (EYN) was founded in 2020, in the midst of pandemic, with a simple goal: to open and democratize digital access for everyone.

Nanda Najmi started a Digital Event Organizer while she was doing her undergraduate to provide affordable event organizer package ensuring that financial constraints would no longer be a barrier for people to stay connected, work, learn, and collaborate during pandemic.

Nanda's dedication did not stop at merely providing access. She built an inclusive support ecosystem with 24/7 customer service and professional talent operators to ensure every customer's events ran obstacle-free. The trust born from this exceptional service and word-of-mouth marketing resulted in massive growth, bringing EYN from zero to more than 15.000 customers in the last five years.

Today, Nanda leads EYN, which has evolved into an IT Consulting & System Integrator Company, continuing to inspire with her commitment to creating customized, technology enabled workspaces that drive seamless collaboration for modern businesses.

By partnering with trusted global technology companies such as Zoom, Google Workspace, Neat, DTEN, Jabra, and AthenaSpace, EYN has been able to deliver enterprise-grade solutions, combining technical depth with a consultative approach in every project, from strategy and design to deployment and long-term support.
